slides.title: Protected Access Specifier
slides.prompt: What is the visibility of 'protected' members of a base class?
options: Accessible inside the base class and its derived classes only
Accessible anywhere in the program via object instances
Accessible only inside the base class itself
Accessible only inside friend functions of the main file
slides.correctAnswer: Accessible inside the base class and its derived classes only

slides.title: Destructor Execution Order
slides.prompt: In what order are destructors executed when a derived object goes out of scope?
